camel_example: aliyun mns-open GetSubscriptionAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionName MySubscription --TopicName MyTopic --version 2022-01-19 --method POST --force
description_en: Retrieves the attributes of a subscription
kebab_example: aliyun mns-open get-subscription-attributes --topic-name MyTopic --subscription-name MySubscription --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSubscriptionAttributes

parameters.help_en: The name of the subscribed topic
parameters.name: topic_name

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the subscription was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: Subscription 的创建时间，为 UTC Unix 秒级时间戳

DeadLetterTargetQueue.description_en: The destination queue for dead-letter message delivery
DeadLetterTargetQueue.description_zh: 死信消息投递目标队列

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether dead-letter message delivery is enabled
Enabled.description_zh: 是否开启死信消息投递

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint address of the subscription

FilterTag.description_en: The tag used for message filtering in the subscription. Only messages with matching tags are pushed
FilterTag.description_zh: 描述了该订阅中消息过滤的标签（仅标签一致的消息才会被推送）

LastModifyTime.description_en: The time when the subscription attributes were last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds in UTC
LastModifyTime.description_zh: Subscription 属性最近一次修改时间，为 UTC Unix 秒级时间戳

NotifyContentFormat.description_en:
The format of the message content pushed to the endpoint. Valid values:

XML

JSON

SIMPLIFIED
NotifyContentFormat.description_zh:
向Endpoint推送的消息内容格式。
取值说明如下：

XML

JSON

SIMPLIFIED

NotifyStrategy.description_en:
The retry strategy used when an error occurs while pushing messages to the endpoint. Valid values:

BACKOFF_RETRY: backoff retry.

EXPONENTIAL_DECAY_RETRY: exponential decay retry
NotifyStrategy.description_zh:
向Endpoint推送消息错误时的重试策略。取值说明如下：

BACKOFF_RETRY：退避重试。

EXPONENTIAL_DECAY_RETRY：指数衰减重试

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether throttling is enabled. Valid values: true or false
Enabled.description_zh: 是否启用限流。取值：true 或 false

MaxReceivesPerSecond.description_en: The maximum number of messages received per second

TopicName.description_en: The name of the subscribed topic

TopicOwner.description_en: The account ID of the owner of the subscribed topic

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
